_about: Background for TAOM's first loading screen (the native view's `loadingscreen_default`, and `loadingscreen_naval` when War Sails is on), chosen by Mike on 2026-10-03 after three ImagineArt rounds. Generated with ImagineArt on Mike's own account at his request.

imagineart_moonlit_smoke_arch.png.reference: one image: ImagineArt asset 7b9c64c8-41a3-4277-8e46-5d2e80df64e5 (round two 'smoke arch'), itself text-only
imagineart_moonlit_smoke_arch.png.prompt: Keep this exact composition: a smoke arch with threads of ghostly flowing Elvish script over a near-black textured surface. Variation: cool moonlit blue-silver tint on the smoke and script, as if lit by a pale moon from above, and the arch kept high so a wide empty dark band runs across the middle of the image (the middle 70 percent of the width and the middle 40 percent of the height contain nothing). The bottom-right corner stays plain and quiet. Very low contrast, moody. No gold, no orange, no fire, no readable words, no logo, no title, no frame.

Main/_Module/AssetSources/LoadingScreen/.how: background scaled to cover 1920 x 1080 (Lanczos) and centre-cropped; the title E:/LOTRAOMAssets/Renders/LOTRAOM_text_only.png (sha256 dd06c148...) scaled to 60 percent of the width (1152 px) and alpha-composited at the exact centre; saved RGB
